title: Troubleshooting: Unexpected Charges on Cobalt Blue
summary: This document helps troubleshoot unexpected Cobalt Blue account charges by identifying the transaction description and matching it to specific fee types: $20 Monthly Maintenance Fee (waiver balance $2,500), $0.25 Excess Transaction Fee per excess item, $20 Domestic Wire Transfer Fee, $2.00 Out-of-Network ATM Fee, and International ATM Withdrawal Fee of 2.5% (minimum $4.00). It also notes Cobalt Blue does not assess overdraft fees, and provides a checklist and required information to request a fee review/dispute.
faqs: How can I identify which Cobalt Blue fee is causing an unexpected charge on my statement?
What balance ($2,500) and statement-period conditions determine the $20 Monthly Maintenance Fee waiver?
How is the Excess Transaction Fee calculated ($0.25 per excess transaction), and how do I confirm the count?
If I see a $20 Wire Transfer Fee – Domestic, how do I verify whether a domestic wire was actually sent?
What ATM fees apply for out-of-network (domestic) vs international withdrawals, and what are the $2.00 / 2.5% (min $4.00) amounts?
If a charge looks like an overdraft fee, does Cobalt Blue assess overdraft fees and what should I do next?
keywords: Excess Transaction Fee ($0.25 per excess transaction)
ATM Fee – Out of Network ($2.00 per ATM transaction)
